messages.subject: Download Button Issue
parts:
I want to upload a simple .csv file, perform some computations on the data, display the operated in a data table, and download the operated data back to a user’s computer using a download button. This seems simple, but is driving me crazy. I am able to upload a file, perform a simple operation to the data, display it in a table, but when go to download the new .csv file it doesn’t show up in the file location I placed it in using the file dialog from the download button. My code is below. The browser in IE 9, and I suspect this could be the problem.

 

#############Call Libs
library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(DT)
 
##############Start Sever Side
server <- function(input, output) {
 
#############Open File and Perform Functions
datasetInput <- reactive({
#############Test File to See if Empty
inFile <- input$file1
if (is.null(inFile))
return(NULL)
###########Read .csv data
tata <- read.csv(inFile$datapath)
###########Operate on Data
rata <- tata * 2
###########Place Operated Data into Data Frame
data <- data.frame(tata, rata, 12)
})
 
#############Insert into Data Table
output$table <- DT::renderDataTable(datasetInput())
 
#############Download Data
output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
##############Assign File Name and Type
filename = function() {paste('data-', Sys.Date(), '.csv', sep='')},
#############Write Data to File
content = function(file) {write.csv(datasetInput(), file)}
)
 
}
#############User Interface Side
ui <- fluidPage(theme = shinytheme("journal"),
 
sidebarPanel(
 
############Place Upload and Download Button Into Well Panel
wellPanel(fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File', accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')),
downloadButton('downloadData', 'Download'))),
 
#############Data Table Output
mainPanel(wellPanel(DT::dataTableOutput('table')))
)
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
